messages:
Alex C: Nightly async — quick standup
Alex C: What I did: drained 2 legacy A100 nodes in us-west1, rolled drivers, validated canary (2k tokens/req). No perf regressions.
Alex C: Blockers: saw one ml-infer pod repeatedly OOMKilled in us-west1 after long sessions; kv-cache growth suspected.
Alex C: Logs snippet:
```
OOMKilled: GC overhead limit exceeded
/var/lib/ml/cache size: 1.8G -> 3.2G over ~45m
```
Alex C: Today: follow up with Jun on eviction policy, prewarm AMS pool, open ticket for quota bump if anything spikes.
Maria G: Thx. I temporarily bumped reservation us-west1-gpu-res +8 for tonight to cover the drains. Will watch usage and revert if unused. :thumbsup:
Jun P: I'll grab the pod logs & thread through the cache GC. Likely missing TTL trim on session close. Quick mitigation: reduce default kv-cache TTL to 10m, patch ready.
Jun P: @Alex C can you paste the pod name? I'll attach and run `kubectl exec` on it.
Alex C: pod name: ml-infer-ksvc-7f8c9d (still in CrashLoopBackoff).
Sam: Quick question — AMS region GPU pool is low on P4s (6 active, quota 8). Are we ok burning 2 for prewarm tonight or should we fallback to spot? @Maria G
Maria G: We can use the temp reservation + set autoscale min to 2 to avoid cold starts. I'll monitor cost delta.
Riley: FYI ops-bot raised a quota alert earlier: `quota compute.googleapis.com/GPUS_P100` at 98% in eu-west, ticket #3456 opened with cloud support.
ops-bot: Alert: quota GPUS_P100 (eu-west) at 98% -> created ticket 3456, status: open.
Alex C: Action items: Jun trim cache TTL + rollout patch, Maria keep reservation & monitor, Sam trigger prewarm AMS 2 nodes, Riley follow up on ticket 3456, I'll sweep for leaked sessions tomorrow 07:00 UTC.
Sam: Prewarm command kicked off at 23:04 UTC: `./scripts/prewarm --region=ams --count=2 --type=p4` — started.
Jun P: Patch pushed & built. Rolling out canary at 23:20 UTC to 5% then 25% if healthy.
Maria G: Noted. If eu-west P100s spike we should route affected traffic to p4a-compatible models in eu-central (fallback policy ready).
Alex C: All good from my side after these steps. No further blockers. Good night all :coffee:
Riley: I'll update ticket 3456 when cloud support replies.
ops-bot: Deployment: jun/cache-trim rolled out to 5% canary at 23:20 UTC.
__notes: Single-thread Slack conversation string; messages are chronological with short, informal updates and actions. Metadata fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md schema.
